name: Krea 2 Turbo FP8
notes: 12B DiT released June 23 2026; native ComfyUI v0.26.0 support same day. FP8 = 12 GB, fits 16 GB with sequential offload. 8-step distilled. New high-quality txt2img backbone alongside SDXL/Flux1/Klein. Commercial use allowed for individuals/small teams. TIER 1.

name: Boogu-Image-0.1-Edit-Turbo
notes: 4-step distilled img2img/inpaint variant of Boogu-Image-0.1 Apache-2.0 family. Released June 30 2026 (strictly in window). FP8 ~10.3 GB. Could add fast 4-step edit path to build_img2img and build_inpaint. TIER 1.

name: LTX2 Context Windows with IC-LoRA
notes: ComfyUI v0.26.0 June 23 2026. Context window sampling for LTX-2 multimodal video+audio with IC-LoRA guide splicing. Enables long-form video within 16 GB VRAM. Supports 2× and 1.5× latent upscale chains. Direct upgrade to build_ltx_video. TIER 1.

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution Nodes
notes: Official NVIDIA integration. RTX Tensor Core VSR: 4K upscaling ~30× faster than diffusion upscalers. ~4 GB VRAM. RTX 5060 Ti fully supported. Complements or replaces build_video_upscale for fast non-diffusion path. Install via ComfyUI Manager. TIER 1.

name: HyperSwap 1a/1b/1c (FaceFusion Labs ONNX)
notes: Three ONNX face-swap checkpoints (speed/balanced/quality) from FaceFusion Labs. Added in ReActor v0.6.2 (April 2025). 1c variant shows higher identity cosine similarity vs inswapper_128. Drop-in replacement for existing swap_model param in build_faceswap. TIER 1.

name: SAM 3.1 (Segment Anything Model 3.1)
notes: Released March 2026 by Meta. Object Multiplex: joint multi-object tracking up to 7× faster, 2× frame rate in medium-density scenes vs SAM 3. Text + exemplar prompts preserved. 6 GB VRAM. Gated HF model — requires access request. Upgrade for build_sam3_segment, build_sam3_mask, build_sam3_extract. TIER 1.

name: BEN2 (Background Erase Network 2)
notes: Confidence Guided Matting pipeline refines low-confidence edge pixels. Outperforms BiRefNet on fine hair matting. 1.13 GB model, ~4 GB VRAM. Already in ComfyUI-RMBG v3.0 node pack. Image and video support, 4K capable. Drop-in upgrade for build_rembg_birefnet. TIER 1.

name: DA3 Native Core Integration + DA3-Streaming
notes: ComfyUI PR merged June 10 2026. Native DA3 nodes: mono + multi-view modes, camera token encoder/decoder. DA3-Streaming: sliding-window video depth <12 GB VRAM. Upgrades build_depth_map_v3 from single-image to streaming video. DA3-Large = 8 GB. TIER 1.

name: Boogu-Image-0.1-Base
notes: 10B Apache-2.0 model released June 16–17 2026; ComfyUI v0.26.0 June 23. FP8 = 10.3 GB, nvfp4 = 5.8 GB. Ultra-dense text rendering at 2K. Qwen3-VL-8B text encoder. New backbone option distinct from SDXL/Flux family. TIER 2.

name: SeeDance 2.0 4K (ByteDance API)
notes: ComfyUI v0.26.1 June 24 2026 (strictly in window). T2V + First-Last-Frame + Reference modes. 4K resolution. API-based (0 local VRAM). Audio sync output. New builder candidate: build_seedance2_video. TIER 2.

name: SeeDance 2.0 Mini (ByteDance API)
notes: ComfyUI v0.26.2 June 25 2026 (in window). Lighter variant of SeeDance 2.0, caps at 720p. API-based. Complements build_wan_flf for first-last-frame workflows. TIER 2.

name: Kling V3-Turbo (API)
notes: ComfyUI v0.26.0 June 23 2026. Faster Kling 3.0: 3–15 s clips, multi-shot prompting (6 shots), audio synthesis, multilingual lip-sync. API-based (0 local VRAM). New builder candidate: build_kling_video. TIER 2.

name: HappyHorse 1.1 (Alibaba API)
notes: ComfyUI v0.26.1 June 24 2026 (in window). Improvements over 1.0: faster motion, up to 9 reference images, reduced sharpening, multilingual lip-sync (7 languages). API-based partner node. TIER 2.

name: ID-LoRA for LTX-2.3 ComfyUI (ECCV 2026)
notes: ECCV 2026. Generates identity-consistent video from reference voice + image using LTX-2.3 + IC-LoRA. Compatible with LTX-2.3 quantized at 16 GB. Extends build_ltx_video for face-consistent character video. TIER 2.

name: FlashVSR v1.1 (CVPR 2026)
notes: CVPR 2026 one-step diffusion streaming video SR. ComfyUI nodes: 1038lab/ComfyUI-FlashVSR, smthemex/ComfyUI_FlashVSR. Tiny mode for <10 GB VRAM. Adds temporal video restoration path missing from build_video_upscale (frame-by-frame). New builder candidate: build_flashvsr_upscale. TIER 2.

name: Qwen-Image ControlNet Union (InstantX)
notes: DiffSynth ControlNet patch (canny/depth/inpaint) + Union LoRA (lineart, softedge, normal, openpose) for Qwen-Image 20B backbone. Extends build_controlnet_gen and build_qwen_edit. Qwen-Image already in Spellcaster stack. TIER 2.

name: LanPaint (training-free universal inpainting)
notes: LanPaintKSampler: training-free inpainting compatible with Krea2, Flux, Klein, SDXL, SD3.5, Qwen-Image, custom LoRAs. No inpaint-specific checkpoint needed. Critical for new Krea2/Boogu backbones without inpaint finetuning. TIER 2.

name: ComfyUI-RMBG v3.0 (1038lab, unified)
notes: Unified node pack: RMBG-2.0, BEN, BEN2, BiRefNet, SAM, SAM2, SAM3, GroundingDINO, INSPYRENET in one interface. Real-time background replacement, enhanced edge detection. Reached v3.0 by Jan 2026. Consolidates build_rembg, build_rembg_birefnet, build_rembg_v3 into a single multi-model node. TIER 2.

name: Tripo v3.0/3.1 ComfyUI Partner Node
notes: Cloud API image/text/multiview-to-3D. Algorithm 3.0: cleaner geometry, high-fidelity textures, Ultra mode up to 2M faces. 3.1 adds production-ready high-detail assets. 0 local VRAM (API). Alternative 3D pipeline to build_hunyuan_3d_textured. New builder candidate: build_tripo_3d. TIER 2.

name: DA3-Streaming (video depth, sliding-window)
notes: Sliding-window streaming video depth inference, <12 GB VRAM. Temporal depth consistency for video workflows. Complements build_depth_map_v3 (currently single-image only). TIER 2.

name: DreamID-V + ComfyUI_JR_DreamID-V
notes: ByteDance ECCV 2026 DiT video face swap with temporal consistency. 16 GB community fork (Goldlionren/ComfyUI_JR_DreamID-V) uses T5 CPU offloading. Wan2.1 VAE + T5. Jan 2026. Extends build_faceswap to video domain. New builder candidate: build_faceswap_video. Marginal VRAM — test on RTX 5060 Ti before wiring. TIER 2.

name: Portrait Engine FLUX / FLUX 2 KLEIN v4.0
notes: Updated v4.0 June 23 2026 (adjacent to window). 158 MB SafeTensor LoRA for Flux.1-dev + Klein 9B. Photorealistic skin texture, micro-detail (pores, hair, blemishes). 33K downloads, 128 reviews. 10 GB VRAM. Drop-in LoRA for build_klein_face_detail. TIER 2.

name: Microsoft Lens 3.8B
notes: May 2026. GPT-OSS-20B MoE text encoder, FLUX.2 semantic VAE. 8 GB VRAM. ComfyUI PR #14077 still open as of July 1 2026. Do not wire until PR merged. TIER 3.

name: PixelDiT 1300M (NVIDIA, CVPR 2026 Best Paper Finalist)
notes: Pixel-space DiT, 6 GB VRAM. ComfyUI PR #14103 merged May 27. Non-commercial NSCLv1 license — incompatible with Spellcaster distribution. PiD upscaling decoder nodes for Flux/Klein/SD3.5 may still be usable (check license scope). TIER 3.

name: Wan 2.7
notes: April 2026. Better quality/audio/motion vs WAN 2.2. Apache-2.0. VRAM: 24 GB unquantized; GGUF variants at 16 GB unconfirmed stable for RTX 5060 Ti. Monitor quantized variants. TIER 3.

name: ColorFLUX (CVPR 2026)
notes: Structure-color decoupling on FLUX with Progressive DPO for old photo colorization. CVPR 2026 paper. No public checkpoint yet. Monitor for weight release to replace build_colorize / build_ddcolor. TIER 3.

name: CanonSwap (ICCV 2025)
notes: Canonical-space video face swap with temporal consistency. ICCV 2025 accepted. Code repo exists (Pixel-Talk/CanonSwap) but weights are 'coming soon'. Do not integrate until checkpoint released. TIER 3.

name: Krea 2 RAW (base, undistilled)
notes: 12B undistilled base checkpoint, June 23 2026. BF16 = 24.76 GB (exceeds 16 GB); GGUF/FP8 community variants fit 16 GB. Primary value is LoRA training surface for the Krea2 architecture. Not a runtime backbone (use Krea 2 Turbo FP8 for inference). TIER 2 (training use only).
